narrNote: Arkansas does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, checked 2026-10-22). An 'Arkansas Alliance of Recovery Residences' describes itself as the state's NARR affiliate, but it is not in NARR's official directory — self-described only, so no affiliate is recorded.
notes: Agency is SAMHSA's Single State Agency for Arkansas (DHS Office of Substance Abuse and Mental Health); no main phone line is published on the OSAMH page (staff contacts are on DHS's Contact OSAMH page), so agency phone is null. COVERAGE CAVEAT for 211: Arkansas 211's operator changed in 2026 to Hark at Excellerate Foundation, and its own site states it is currently only able to serve Benton, Madison, and Washington counties (Northwest Arkansas) after operating statewide 2019-2025 — callers elsewhere in Arkansas may reach limited service; dial 2-1-1 / 866-489-6983 / text ZIP to 898211. The Arkansas Crisis Center (Bentonville) answers Arkansas's 988 calls statewide; its site now directs callers to 988 (its historic direct line was 1-888-274-7472). BACKFILL 2026-10-22: countyDirectory now records DHS OSAMH's 'Find Substance Abuse or Mental Health Treatment' page — fetched and content-verified on humanservices.arkansas.gov; it links the state-funded SUD treatment directories (8 catchment areas), Community Mental Health Centers, and opioid treatment providers. medicaidSud now records OSAMH's official FAQ (fetched and verified), whose first answer enumerates the behavioral-health services Arkansas Medicaid covers, including Peer Support Aftercare Recovery Support for substance abuse. Wolfe Street Foundation is now listed in peerOrgs: its official site was fetched and verified on 2026-10-22 — Arkansas's leading recovery community organization (Little Rock, since 1982), offering peer recovery support services, certified recovery residences, and 60+ weekly AA/NA and other mutual-aid meetings at its Recovery Community Center.
